project: Bernried / Haus der Komischen Kunst / 3. BA / LPH 3

cases.title: Umsetzungskonzeption is contractual basis, not a finished room program
cases.given: The Völker concept is a contractual/planning basis but does not define every room or final design decision.
cases.expected: MINDS may use it as a governing source, but must not report every programmatic recommendation as an accepted current project fact.

cases.title: Gastronomy source conflict survives retrieval
cases.given: The 2024 Vorentwurf describes a larger gastronomy model; the later concept and Bauherr feedback reduce it.
cases.expected: A query about current gastronomy must bring the superseding/contradicting basis with the old claim instead of returning the old confirmed figure alone.

cases.title: Cafe-Shop-Ticketing integration is traceable to Bauherr feedback
cases.given: Bauherr asked to integrate Ausgabe, Shop-Kasse, Ticketing and Besucherinformation so winter operation can be handled by one person.
cases.expected: The current project reading may treat the integration as a Bauherr decision, while preserving the exact source and later implementation state.

cases.title: Luftraum decision keeps decision history
cases.given: Multiple Luftraum variants were studied and the 05.10 presentation explicitly references the decision state from 07.09.
cases.expected: MINDS distinguishes studied variants from the accepted direction and can answer what changed, when, and on whose decision.

cases.title: Three workplaces do not imply three separate offices
cases.given: The operating concept requires at least three staff; Bauherr feedback accepts the office area for three workplaces and asks for meeting capacity.
cases.expected: MINDS must not invent a separate room per role; it records the operational requirement and the later spatial decision separately.

cases.title: Workshop room integration does not erase its equipment requirement
cases.given: Werkstatt is to be integrated into Lager/Depot and a washbasin provided.
cases.expected: Reorganization of the room does not delete the functional requirement; the project model keeps both the adopted spatial change and the equipment movement.

cases.title: Annual visitors are not simultaneity
cases.given: 25,000 annual visitors are used as a basis for Garderobe/WC discussion, while simultaneity scenarios are separately required.
cases.expected: MINDS must not infer exact simultaneous occupancy or sanitary counts solely from annual visitors.

cases.title: Lastenaufzug remains open until artwork/manufacturer information arrives
cases.given: Dimensions are to be adapted once more information about artwork dimensions is available; manufacturer planning is still referenced.
cases.expected: MINDS keeps this as an open movement/expectation and does not close it because a provisional shaft/cabin appears on a plan.

cases.title: Preliminary planning basis sent to TWP/HLS is a milestone, not approval
cases.given: M01 records preliminary planning documents sent to TWP/HLS on 24.09.2026.
cases.expected: MINDS can say they were transmitted, but must not infer that TWP/HLS accepted them or that coordination is complete.

cases.title: Fachplaner questions due 08.10 must return on time
cases.given: Fachplaner are scheduled to review planning bases and compile questions from 05.10 to 08.10.
cases.expected: Before or on 08.10 MINDS surfaces the anchor with useful lead time and names who owns the next movement.

cases.title: BRS and ELT are conditional because commissioning is unresolved
cases.given: BRS and ELT contributions for 09.10–23.10 are explicitly marked vorbehaltlich Beauftragung.
cases.expected: MINDS must not present their delivery as guaranteed; the commissioning condition remains visible and itself may require attention.

cases.title: HLS and TWP first contributions target 23.10
cases.given: HLS and TWP Arbeitsstand 01 run 09.10–23.10, with M03 on 23.10.
cases.expected: The project model keeps these future returns active through unrelated project activity and surfaces slippage or missing delivery.

cases.title: Bauherr review of Vorabzug 02 ends 09.10
cases.given: The Bauherr review phase for Vorabzug 02 is scheduled 02.10–09.10; the plan then lists "Abstimmung Planstand Vorabzug 02 abgeschlossen" on 09.10.
cases.expected: MINDS distinguishes a due review from a received review and must not mark it complete merely because the date arrives.

cases.title: Schnittstellenliste has a bounded coordination window
cases.given: ARC + Fachplaner are to coordinate and freeze the interface list from 05.10 to 09.10.
cases.expected: MINDS can identify unresolved interfaces as blockers and show what source/meeting created each one.

cases.title: Genehmigungsfähigkeit precheck is active 05.10–16.10
cases.given: ARC prechecks permit feasibility and authority requirements in a defined period.
cases.expected: Before the precheck closes, external-facing statements about permit feasibility remain qualified unless separately supported.

cases.title: Decision points must be assembled before M04
cases.given: Coordination issues are documented 26.10–02.11 and M04 sends decision points to Auftraggeber on 02.11.
cases.expected: MINDS organizes unresolved project questions into a coherent decision set without silently converting inferred issues into accepted facts.

cases.title: M05 is a real decision event, not generic calendar context
cases.given: The Auftraggeber decision meeting for Arbeitsstand 02 is scheduled 09.11.
cases.expected: Prior briefing distinguishes decisions required from information only; after the meeting, status changes require evidence of actual decisions.

cases.title: LPH3 design coordination closes only with M06 evidence
cases.given: M06 marks completion of Entwurfsstand LPH3 coordination with Auftraggeber on 20.11.
cases.expected: Earlier internal completion or a generated summary cannot promote the project to coordinated status.

cases.title: Final Fachplaner contributions feed cost calculation
cases.given: Coordinated Fachplaner contributions target 04.12 and are upstream of quantity/cost consolidation and M08 on 10.12.
cases.expected: MINDS exposes the dependency chain and flags cost confidence if a required Fachplaner contribution is missing or conditional.

cases.title: Final silence is coverage-qualified through delivery
cases.given: Internal completion is 16.12, reserve 17.12 and external handover M10 on 18.12.
cases.expected: A calm project status before 18.12 is only valid relative to known coverage; missing sources, unreadable files or unobserved external channels are stated explicitly.
